main.description: Pushes one of the requesting user's social.colibri.beta.actor.spaceModeration records to the AppView, so it takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a sync notification. The client writes or deletes the record in its own personal space first, then calls this.

hideModeratedMessages.description: The new option for this community. Absent together with remove returns the community to the global option.

remove.description: Removes the community's options so it follows the global ones. Ignored when hideModeratedMessages is present.

preferences.description: The requesting user's settings, after the update.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Neither hideModeratedMessages nor remove is present.
